question: Who among the following surpassed Argentine superstar Lionel Messi to become the second-highest active international goal-scorer in June 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunil Chhetri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sunil Chhetri is an Indian professional footballer who plays as a forward and captains both the Indian Super League side Bengaluru FC and the Indian national team.
 
• As of June 2021, Sunil Chhetri surpassed Lionel Messi to become the second-highest active international goal-scorer, with 74 goals.
 
• Sunil Chhetri is considered one of the greatest footballers in Indian history and has received numerous accolades for his contributions to Indian football.
 
• He has been awarded the AIFF Player of the Year a record six times and has been instrumental in India's performance in international tournaments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lionel Messi:**

 
 
• He is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Paris Saint-Germain and the Argentina national team.
 
• Messi is widely regarded as one of the greatest footballers of all time.
 
• He has won the Ballon d'Or award seven times, which is the most by any player in history.
 
 
 
• **Cristiano Ronaldo:**
 
 
• He is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Al Nassr and the Portugal national team.
 
• As of June 2021, Cristiano Ronaldo is the highest active international goal-scorer.
 
• Ronaldo has won the Ballon d'Or award five times.
 
 
 
• **AIFF (All India Football Federation):**
 
 
• It is the governing body of football in India under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
 
• The AIFF is responsible for the development and promotion of football in India.
 
• It organizes various leagues and tournaments, including the Indian Super League and I-League.
 
 
 
• **International Goals:**
 
 
• International goals refer to the goals scored by a footballer in matches representing their national team.
 
• These matches include official tournaments like the FIFA World Cup, continental championships, and international friendlies.
 
• Scoring international goals is considered a significant achievement and contributes to a player's legacy in the sport.
